text:
morgan: Follow-up from PM: recurring KV eviction spikes at peak. Need runbook edits, owner assignments, and clear pager rules.
incident-bot: Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-kv-eviction-summary (artifacts attached).
priya: I'll own the escalation matrix and playbook language. @dan can you own the runbook docs?
dan: I can. Will update docs/runbooks/kv-evictions.md and open a PR. Target date for PR: 2026-04-08.
ash: I'll draft the minimal triage commands for on-call. Draft snippet: 
```
# quick triage (KV evictions)
1) pods: kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide
2) logs: kubectl logs -l app=runtime -n inference --tail 120 | grep -i eviction
3) metrics: curl -fsS http://monitoring.internal/metrics?svc=runtime | jq '.kv_cache_evictions'
4) if evictions > 60/min: patch batch_size and restart:
   kubectl patch configmap rt-config -n inference --type merge -p '{"data":{"batch_size":"1"}}'
   kubectl rollout restart deployment/rt-gateway -n inference
5) post-restart smoke: curl -sS http://rt-gateway.internal/healthz && http POST http://rt-gateway.internal/v1/generate prompt='warmup'
```
lee: I'll make a tiny smoke script for step 5 and put it in a gist for the PR.
priya: Paging rules: page @oncall at 10m, page @runtime-leads at 30m, page @dedicated-esc immediately if Dedicated tenant affected. Include contact list and who to cc.
morgan: Let's create INCs and owners now so we can track. I'll open tickets and post IDs here.
morgan: Created follow-ups: INC-8001 (runbook update) -> owner: dan, due: 2026-04-08; INC-8002 (triage commands + smoke script) -> owner: ash+lee, due: 2026-04-04; INC-8003 (escalation matrix + pager updates) -> owner: priya, due: 2026-04-02.
dan: ACK. I'll include regression check: weekly eviction-rate job that alerts if >3 spikes in 24h. Add to INC-8001.
ash: Added auth note for rt-admin kv dump endpoint and a safe dump command: `curl -u svc-sre:token -X POST http://rt-admin.internal/dump_kv | gzip -c > kv_dump.gz`
lee: Gist with smoke script: https://gist.internal/kv-warmup-check.sh (linked in PR).
dan: Opening PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/1968 tagging @priya @ash for review. ETA merge: 2026-04-08 EOD.
morgan: Excellent. I'll track closure in the postmortem follow-ups doc and mark resolved when INCs close. Thanks all :thumbsup:
